title: MPC signer
description: Threshold-ECDSA signer: nodes, signing, presignature pool

panels.title: Critical firing
panels.description: Critical alerts firing now (all components). Details in the table and on Prometheus's Alerts page.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Every alert firing now, critical first. 'Firing for' counts from when the condition started (including the rule's wait time). History: the Alert log dashboard.

targets.expr: max by (alertname, severity, subject) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace((ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="critical"} * 3 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing",severity="warning"} * 2 or ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}), "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

max by (alertname, severity, subject) ((time() - label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS_FOR_STATE, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)")) and on(alertname, severity, subject) label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}, "subject", "$1", "instance", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "host", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "address", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "sender", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "node", "(.+)"), "subject", "$1", "section", "(.+)"))

panels.title: MPC nodes up
panels.description: Signing needs the threshold (2 of 3). Red below the threshold: no signature possible.

panels.title: Presignatures ready
panels.description: Hot-path presignatures across the hot keys (MPC_POOL_KEYS).

panels.title: MPC nodes
panels.description: Reachability of each MPC node from each coordinator (GET /health every 10 s). Down from one coordinator only: the network path between those two hosts.

panels.title: Signatures per second
panels.description: hot = from a presignature (fast). cold = full interactive protocol: normal for user keys outside MPC_POOL_KEYS; for a hot sender it means the pool ran empty.

panels.title: Failures
panels.description: Policy refusals: chain id, value, gas or destination outside cluster.json policy.

panels.title: Presignature pools (one per MPC key and coordinator; filter with Class, Section and Search above)
Pooled keys
panels.description: Keys with a presignature pool (classes big and small; 'none' keys always sign the slow way), matching the filters

targets.expr: count(count by (address) (((max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class"}) * on(address) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) or label_replace(max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) unless on(address) max by (address) (proxy_account_info), "account", "$1", "address", "(.*)")))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Empty pools
panels.description: Pools with no presignature: that key signs the slow way (~0.6-1.5 s) until it refills (alert MpcPoolEmpty for big keys)

targets.expr: count(((max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class"}) * on(address) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) or label_replace(max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) unless on(address) max by (address) (proxy_account_info), "account", "$1", "address", "(.*)")) == 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Below half
panels.description: Pools under half of their target: signing faster than presigning

targets.expr: count((((max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class"}) * on(address) group_left(account, kind, section) (max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",account=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) or max by (address, account, kind, section) (proxy_account_info{section=~"$section",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}))) or label_replace(max by (address, class, name) (mpc_pool_ready{job="mpc-coordinator",instance=~"$coordinator",class=~"$class",address=~"(?i).*$search.*"}) unless on(address) max by (address) (proxy_account_info), "account", "$1", "address", "(.*)")) / on(class, name) group_left() max by (class, name) (mpc_pool_target{job="mpc-coordinator"} > 0)) < 0.5) or vector(0)

panels.title: Presignatures ready
panels.description: In the pools matching the filters

panels.title: Pools of small keys
panels.description: Small pools (e.g. accounts from /createaccount), summed per coordinator: one line per account would be unreadable. A small key with an empty pool signs cold until its pool refills. A coordinator with MPC_POOL_TARGET_SMALL=0 keeps no small pools.

targets.legendFormat: {{name}} small keys with an empty pool

panels.title: Presignatures generated per second
panels.description: This is the sustained hot-path capacity: signatures/s above it drain the pool.

panels.title: Keys per pool class
panels.description: big = MPC_POOL_TARGET presignatures each, small = MPC_POOL_TARGET_SMALL, none = cold signing. Change an account's class: POST /account/pool on the proxy.

panels.title: MPC node reachability
panels.description: Each coordinator checks every MPC node, so there is one line per coordinator and node (coord1 → node 0 ...). 1 = the node answers that coordinator. Node 0 = mpc1 (.135), node 1 = mpc2 (.137), node 2 = mpc3 (.138).
